description: Return Ramadan start/end for a Gregorian year (observed or estimated) and the officially published reduced working-hour rules for the emirate/sector (e.g. federal 09:00–14:30 Mon–Thu, 09:00–12:00 Fri; private sector −2 hours/day). If no rule has been published for that profile the response says 'not_announced' instead of guessing. Use for scheduling during Ramadan and for HR policy questions. Example: {year:2026, emirate:'federal', sector:'public'} → 18 Feb–19 Mar 2026, confirmed, FAHR Circular 1/2026 hours. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
sector.title: Sector
